faction.golkar_pillars.label: The three pillars of Golkar: ABRI, Bureaucracy and Golkar
faction.golkar_pillars.abri.name: ABRI
faction.golkar_pillars.abri.desc: The armed forces are too entrenched in the state. Territorial commands from Kodam down to Koramil shadow every level of civilian government, and the officer corps sits inside the legislatures, the cabinet and the regional governorships.
faction.golkar_pillars.birokrasi.name: Bureaucracy
faction.golkar_pillars.birokrasi.desc: The civil service is staffed by Golkar loyalists and old guards. Every ministry and regional office is run by officials who came up through KORPRI and owe their careers to the party, and they vote as they are told.
faction.golkar_pillars.golkar.name: Golkar
faction.golkar_pillars.golkar.desc: The Functional Groups: not a party in name, but an electoral machine that fused patronage, business money and the state. It has won every election since 1971 by pooling the loyalty of the other two pillars.
faction.golkar_pillars.abri.effect: While it stands, Golkar resists your influence permanently. Every gain with a Golkar bloc is cut by $RESIST$%.
faction.golkar_pillars.birokrasi.effect: While it stands, the bureaucracy slow-walks your orders. You earn $PCMALUS$% less Political Capital from every source.
faction.golkar_pillars.golkar.effect: While it stands, the party machine keeps propping up the Cendana network. Cendana Influence creeps back up by $DRIFT$ at the end of every turn.
faction.golkar_pillars.unlock_note: Until all three pillars are broken, the decrees that abolish Golkar's seats stay locked.

military.patience.title: The Military's Patience
military.patience.note: Wears down every turn when the generals are ignored. Meeting with them holds it, and anything that angers them burns it faster. At zero it turns to §Ranger§!, and anger can cost you up to §R$MAX$%§! of what other factions give you, and of your §BPolitical Capital§! income.
military.patience.note_zero: Wears down every turn the generals are ignored; meeting them holds it, and anything that angers them burns it faster. At zero it turns to §Ranger§!. On this difficulty the anger will not weaken your other dealings, but the generals will be slow to forgive.
military.anger.title: The Military's Anger
military.anger.note: Climbs every turn, and climbs faster when you anger them again. Other factions give you §R$RES$%§! less from deals, decrees, actions and events (at most §R$MAX$%§!), and your §BPolitical Capital§! income is cut by the same amount. Reconciliation with the military occurs §R$STUB$%§! more slowly. Meeting with them eases it a little, and a warm relationship stops it climbing and slowly bleeds it away.
military.anger.note_zero: Climbs every turn, and climbs faster when you anger them again. On this difficulty it does not weaken your other dealings, but the generals warm to you §R$STUB$%§! more slowly. Meeting them eases it a little, and a warm relationship (TNI loyalty above 55) bleeds it away.
military.resist_line: §RThe military's interference cuts what this faction gives you by $RES$%.§!
military.status.line: Military interference cuts your gains by $RES$%.

pdip.tier.0.label: Standing Down
pdip.tier.1.label: Guarded Watchfulness
pdip.tier.2.label: Simmering Unrest
pdip.tier.3.label: Mass Mobilization
pdip.tier.4.label: Active Riots
pdip.note.0: The red shirts wait on Kebagusan. Mobilization climbs every turn you do not deal with PDI Perjuangan, and climbs faster the more hostile Megawati's camp is; winning them over eases it. Each time it passes §R25%§!, §R50%§!, §R75%§! and §R100%§! the street demands more loudly that Habibie must go: §BPolitical Capital§!, §DPopularity§! and §MReformasi Credibility§! gains §Rshrink§!, PDI Perjuangan grows §Rharder to win and costlier to talk to§!, and at §R100%§! they §Rvote to reject to the last delegate§!.
pdip.note.n: Habibie must go, says the street. Riding on a wave of the Spirit of Reformasi, Megawati's redshirts take to the streets. Gains of §BPolitical Capital§!, §DPopularity§! and §MReformasi Credibility§! are cut by §R$CUT$%§!, PDI Perjuangan warms to you §R$MG$%§! more slowly and votes §R$ADJ$§! points against you on the floor, and its negotiators now charge §R×$MULT$§!. At §R100%§! the bloc votes to §Rreject to the last delegate.§!
pdip.note.4: Total mobilization. Gains of §BPolitical Capital§!, §DPopularity§! and §MReformasi Credibility§! are cut by §R$CUT$%§!, PDI Perjuangan's negotiators charge §R×$MULT$§!, and the bloc will §Rvote to reject to the last delegate§!, with no defection and no abstention.

ucn.slider.pc.name: Empty Palace Coffers
ucn.slider.pc.desc: Suharto's abrupt resignation leaves Bina Graha with almost no political capital in reserve.
ucn.slider.s_pop.name: Suharto's Shadow
ucn.slider.s_pop.desc: The public sees you as the Old Man's handpicked protégé rather than a genuine transitional leader.
ucn.slider.s_mil.name: Cilangkap Hawks
ucn.slider.s_mil.desc: ABRI headquarters views a civilian engineer in the presidency with cold suspicion.
ucn.slider.s_ref.name: Trisakti Distrust
ucn.slider.s_ref.desc: Student presidiums occupying the streets refuse to believe ICMI insiders will dismantle the New Order.
ucn.slider.s_econ.name: Krismon Freefall
ucn.slider.s_econ.desc: The rupiah is at Rp 15,000 to the dollar, banks are insolvent, and basic goods are vanishing.
ucn.slider.s_intl.name: IMF Letter of Intent
ucn.slider.s_intl.desc: Washington and the IMF withhold bailout tranches until Jakarta proves it can service its debt.
ucn.slider.s_stab.name: Ashes of May 1998
ucn.slider.s_stab.desc: Burned-out shopping districts and communal flashpoints leave the archipelago one spark from chaos.
ucn.slider.s_cendana.name: Fortress Cendana
ucn.slider.s_cendana.desc: The First Family's monopolies, foundations, and loyalists remain deeply embedded across the state.
ucn.slider.s_goodwill.name: Cold Reception at Senayan
ucn.slider.s_goodwill.desc: Parliamentary party bosses distance themselves from the Palace ahead of the general session.
ucn.slider.s_goodwill.value: Every faction opens $V$ from its normal start.
ucn.slider.cost.name: Senayan Tollgate
ucn.slider.cost.desc: Committee chairmen and ministry mandarins extract steeper political concessions for every signature.
ucn.slider.cost.value: Faction actions +$C$%, decrees +$D$%, and +$F$ PC on every action.
ucn.slider.cooldown.name: Ministerial Foot-Dragging
ucn.slider.cooldown.desc: New Order holdovers slow-walk presidential directives, delaying follow-up initiatives.
ucn.slider.passive.name: Caretaker Lame Duck
ucn.slider.passive.desc: Treated as a temporary seat-warmer, the presidency bleeds political authority each month.
ucn.slider.malus.name: Cracks in the Republic
ucn.slider.malus.desc: Whenever national stability falters, parliamentary caucuses abandon the Palace in droves.
ucn.slider.malus.value: Loyalty drain capped at $V$ pts per turn.
ucn.slider.bad.name: Hostile Press Syndicate
ucn.slider.bad.desc: Newly uncensored tabloids and opposition dailies turn every misstep into a national scandal.
ucn.slider.good.name: Public Cynicism
ucn.slider.good.desc: After thirty-two years of state propaganda, voters greet Palace victories with deep skepticism.
ucn.slider.yield.name: Hotel Mulia Extortion
ucn.slider.yield.desc: Backroom brokers in the Hotel Mulia suites pocket your concessions while promising very little.
ucn.slider.favor.name: Broken Backroom Vows
ucn.slider.favor.desc: Party whips refuse to let the Palace bank long-term political IOUs.
ucn.slider.favor.value: At most $V$ banked favor(s) per faction.
ucn.slider.erosion.name: Shifting Party Loyalties
ucn.slider.erosion.desc: Coalition goodwill evaporates each turn unless continually renewed with fresh patronage.
ucn.slider.erosion.value: Surplus support decays $V$ pts per turn.
ucn.slider.regen.name: Yayasan Slush Funds
ucn.slider.regen.desc: Off-budget foundations quietly bankroll Cendana's return behind your back every turn.
ucn.slider.regen.value: Cendana regrows about $V$ pts per turn.
ucn.slider.army.name: Dwifungsi Hardliners
ucn.slider.army.desc: Territorial commanders bristle at civilian oversight, escalating military grievance and incidents.
ucn.slider.defect.name: Night of the Long Knives
ucn.slider.defect.desc: Under cover of the secret ballot, professed allies cross the aisle to knife your accountability speech.
ucn.slider.chaos.name: Pandemonium in Senayan
ucn.slider.chaos.desc: Fierce floor walkouts, wildcard delegations, and midnight horse-trading rock the plenary hall.
ucn.slider.chaos.value: Mood swing +/-$M$, wildcards in $W$% of blocs, crossover $X$%.
ucn.slider.military.name: Generals' Ultimatum
ucn.slider.military.desc: The high command's patience wears razor-thin, its anger paralyses state action, and it refuses to forgive.
ucn.slider.military.value: Anger cuts up to §R$C$%§! of gains/§BPC§!. Patience §R-$D$§!/turn, anger §R+$R$§!/turn, goodwill §R-$S$%§! slower, calm §B-$K$§!.
ucn.slider.pdip.name: Kebagusan Red Tide
ucn.slider.pdip.desc: Megawati's grassroot masses flood the avenues, choking Palace momentum and pricing out negotiations.
ucn.slider.pdip.value: Starts at §R$S$%§! (§R+$R$§!/turn). Cuts §BPC§!/§DPop§!/§MRef§! by §R$C$%§!/tier, goodwill §R-$G$%§!, max cost §R×$M$§!.
election.plenary_title: 12th Plenary Sitting of the 1999 MPR General Session
election.win_overwhelming.title: A NEW MANDATE
election.win_overwhelming.desc: The Nusantara Building erupts as the final ballots are read aloud. Defying every forecast in Jakarta, the Assembly has ratified your Pertanggungjawaban by a sweeping margin, turning a caretaker presidency into an unassailable mandate through 2004.
election.win_comfortable.title: THE COALITION HOLDS FIRM
election.win_comfortable.desc: Despite weeks of backroom intrigue at the Hotel Mulia, your floor whips kept the blocs in line. The Assembly has formally accepted your Pertanggungjawaban with breathing room to spare, clearing the runway for your presidential bid.
election.win_narrow.title: SURVIVAL BEFORE DAWN
election.win_narrow.desc: A breathless count in the dead of night. As the last slips of paper are tallied at the rostrum, your Pertanggungjawaban clears the chamber by a razor's edge.
election.lose_narrow.title: UNDONE BEHIND THE CURTAIN
election.lose_narrow.desc: Promises made in the hotel suites evaporated inside the voting booths. Pulled down by last-minute defections under the cover of the secret ballot, your Pertanggungjawaban falls agonizingly short before dawn.
election.lose_decisive.title: ACCOUNTABILITY REJECTED
election.lose_decisive.desc: Chairman Amien Rais brings the gavel down over a restless hall. The Assembly has decisively voted down your Pertanggungjawaban, bringing your seventeen-month caretaker presidency to its close.
election.lose_overwhelming.title: REPUDIATED BY THE ASSEMBLY
election.lose_overwhelming.desc: A wholesale mutiny on the Senayan floor. Uniting across every ideological fault line, the delegates have buried your Pertanggungjawaban in a historic landslide.
menu.roll_call_in_progress: The clerks are still counting the ballots in Senayan. Wait for the tally, or press SKIP TO FINAL COUNT.
election.quorum_failure: The ayes outnumber the nays, but $VOTES$ votes fall short of the 351 needed for an absolute majority of the original Assembly.
